name: HSBC RedCoin
oneLiner: HSBC RedCoin (RCHKD) is an HKD stablecoin issued by HSBC under an HKMA licence, available through PayMe since October 2026 on HSBC's private permissioned chain.
collateral: 1:1 HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets held in segregated accounts under HKMA Stablecoins Ordinance requirements
pegMechanism: HKD fiat-referenced stablecoin issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited on HSBC's private permissioned chain. HSBC describes 1:1 backing by segregated HKD-denominated reserve assets and redemption at par through permitted channels, subject to its terms.
launchPhaseDetail: HKMA-licensed stablecoin issuer FRS02, effective April 10 2026. HSBC named the token HSBC RedCoin on September 30 2026 and launched it on October 23 2026 under the ticker RCHKD, available on PayMe by HSBC (3.3M users) for peer-to-peer and merchant payments, with HSBC Digital Assets Custody providing safekeeping. HSBC plans to add wallet functionality to the HSBC HK Mobile Banking App and tokenized investment subscriptions later in 2026. 1:1 backed by HKD-denominated high-quality liquid assets in segregated accounts. HSBC now publishes issuer-reported circulation and reserve figures. Pharos keeps RCHKD in pre-launch until public on-chain issuance and a verifiable price and supply path exist.

milestones.title: HKMA grants stablecoin issuer licence to HSBC
milestones.description: The HKMA grants The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited a stablecoin issuer licence under the Stablecoins Ordinance, effective April 10 2026.

milestones.title: HSBC names its Hong Kong dollar stablecoin HSBC RedCoin
milestones.description: HSBC named its planned HKD stablecoin HSBC RedCoin and stated that at launch it will be offered only through PayMe and the HSBC HK Mobile App, restating a launch plan for the second half of 2026.

milestones.title: HSBC RedCoin (RCHKD) launches on PayMe
milestones.description: HSBC made HSBC RedCoin, ticker RCHKD, available on PayMe by HSBC from October 23 2026 under its HKMA stablecoin issuer licence, with HSBC Digital Assets Custody providing safekeeping. HSBC plans to add stablecoin wallet functionality to the HSBC HK Mobile Banking App later in 2026. The release names no blockchain and gives no circulation or reserve figures.
